notes.text: The sheet is headed SGA 4 VI and Sommaire. It carries no date. The right column allocates 1 à 19, 20 à 37, 38 à 46 and 47 à 65 to the first four entries. The lower-left 17 is recorded only as an archive sheet-number comment.
notes.basis: Observation: headings, right marginal ranges and lower-left corner in the whole and halves; top-note crop 01 does not establish a date.

notes.text: The first three entries concern finiteness of objects/arrows, topoi and morphisms of topoi. The cancelled Constructibilité entry is replaced by finiteness for a topos obtained by recollement, with obtenu par added above the line.
notes.basis: Observation: items 1–4 in half a; no mathematical derivation or proof check.

notes.text: The Cohomologie d'une limite inductive item is relabelled 9 to 5 and circled. A long left pencil arrow carries it up to the divider after item 4. The adjacent entries are relabelled 5 to 6, 6 to 7, uncertain 7 to 8, and 8 to uncertain 8/9. A source query and a brace are separate editorial marks.
notes.basis: Observation: half a and crops 05–11. The interpretation as relocation follows the drawn endpoint/arrowhead; no intended numeric scheme was used to resolve an obscured digit.

notes.text: The handwritten appendix is attributed on the sheet to P. Deligne. Its earlier title begins with uncertain Existence de points, is cancelled, and is revised to Un topos cohérent a, followed by an inserted uncertain suffisamment de points.
notes.basis: Observation: handwritten item 10, half a and crop 14. The mathematical assertion is transcribed only, not established or proof-checked.

notes.text: The cancelled NB discusses interchanging its referenced item with a block whose corrected endpoints are difficult, and favors consecutive treatment of the two facettes du passage à la limite en cohomologie. It says the referenced numéro 8 would be reduced to une ou deux pages because the finiteness sorite is already done.
notes.basis: Observation: complete first lower paragraph in half b; numeral and overprint crops 15–19. This is an editorial plan, not a checked mathematical theorem.

notes.text: The second cancelled paragraph proposes a constructibility sorite for groups, torsion sheaves, Modules and complexes of Modules, including special locally noetherian facts. It contains Je pense que je le rédigerai mais ne le garantis pas, a qualified writing plan. The source x-cancelled wording is the incomplete à la rigue.
notes.basis: Observation: complete second lower paragraph in half b and crops 20–21. No proof event is implied by the author's proposed rédaction.

notes.text: The third typed paragraph is crossed by the same large pencil cancellation as the first two. It says the rédaction of numbers 1 à 3 is àomplète, with a separate m/p overprint, and promises further examples. Its cancelled morphism example is followed by the bottom addition about a topos with a generating family of coherent objects which is not locally algebraic. The addition's final s and its own cancellation state remain uncertain.
notes.basis: Observation: complete third paragraph and both bottom lines in half b; crops 22–24. The long crossing stroke is observed; chronology of the insertion versus cancellation is not inferred.

notes.text: Every letter in SGA 4 VI, Sommaire, Lim and the other typed capitals was separately inspected for duplicated strikes. Only the heading S is recorded as definite repeated same-letter striking. The c/x, s/f, g/u and p/m cells are distinct superpositions; no order is assigned. The red o-shaped correction in tomber retains its uncertain black underprint.
notes.basis: Observation: both halves and the respective single crops 02, 12, 17, 18, 21 and 22. No heavier type alone was treated as a distinct earlier character.

notes.text: The handwritten marks are described without an independent identification of their writer. H's editorial account of authorship/publication and other pages was not imported into the source transcription. Its accurate verbal drawing descriptions are explicitly acknowledged where the reading now supplies TikZ.
notes.basis: Method/source boundary: this page only; no other pages, readers, OCR, external texts or research were consulted.

notes.text: No mathematical proof check, independent re-proof or computation occurred. The mathematical content served only to locate potentially consequential notation and section-reference ambiguities. Prose dash/ellipsis encoding differences alone were not counted; the absent top-note dash is a source-mark issue.
notes.basis: Epistemic status of this reader run; check_events is intentionally empty.
